title_zh: Talking on the phone – 15 – English at Work has the top tips for you
title_en: Talking on the phone – 15 – English at Work has the top tips for you
videoTitle: Talking on the phone – 15 – English at Work has the top tips for you
textbookTitle_zh: 办公室电话：报上公司名，对方不在就留口信
note_zh: 整集 5:11。BBC Learning English《English at Work》第 15 集，演员真人配音，字幕即官方台词。片尾旁白把句型又念了一遍。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Yes?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: Stop! That's all wrong. I'm going to call you again. This time, you don't say yes when you answer. It's rude.
sentences.zh: 停！这样完全不对。我再打一次。接电话不要说 yes，这很无礼。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: Here we are in the middle of a telephone training session with Denise and Anna.
sentences.zh: 我们正在看 Denise 给 Anna 做电话训练。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: Call me and I'll show you how it's done. Hello? Tip Top Trading.
sentences.zh: 你打给我，我示范。你好，Tip Top Trading。
sentences.note: Hello? 加上公司名，比单说 yes 像在办公。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Wow, that's good.
sentences.zh: 哇，这样好多了。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: And you can say your name. Hello? Tip Top Trading. Denise speaking. Try it.
sentences.zh: 还可以报自己的名字。你好，Tip Top Trading，我是 Denise。你试。
sentences.note: Denise speaking. 接起电话报自己是谁。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello? Tip Top Trading. Denise speaking.
sentences.zh: 你好，Tip Top Trading，我是 Denise。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: No! Say Anna speaking.
sentences.zh: 不对！说你是 Anna。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Oh, sorry, I'm so stressed by all this. Hello, Anna speaking.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我被这些搞得好紧张。你好，我是 Anna。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: You sound like you're sitting on a pineapple. Listen: Hello? Denise speaking.
sentences.zh: 你听起来像坐在菠萝上。听我的：你好，我是 Denise。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello? Anna speaking.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是 Anna。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: Good. When they introduce themselves, say: Hello Mrs Smith, how can I help you? If you know them, you might say: Hello Mrs Smith, how are you?
sentences.zh: 好。对方报了名字，你说：Smith 太太你好，我能帮你什么？如果认识，可以说：Smith 太太你好，你好吗？
sentences.note: How can I help you? 接起商务电话后的第一句。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: What if Mrs Smith wants to speak to Tom, but he's not there?
sentences.zh: 如果 Smith 太太要找 Tom，可是他不在呢？

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: You say: I'm really sorry, he's not available at the moment. Can I take a message? Or: I'm afraid he's busy. Shall I ask him to call you back?
sentences.zh: 你说：真抱歉，他这会儿不在。我能记下口信吗？或者：他正忙。要我让他回你电话吗？
sentences.note: I'm afraid… 比 he's busy 婉转，后面通常跟着替代办法。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: To end a conversation, you can say: Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 结束时可以说：谢谢来电，再见。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello? Tip Top Trading.
sentences.zh: 你好，Tip Top Trading。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: Hello, this is Mrs Smith.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是 Smith 太太。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello Mrs Smith, how can I help you?
sentences.zh: Smith 太太你好，我能帮你什么？

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: I'd like to speak to Tom, please.
sentences.zh: 请找 Tom。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: I'm really sorry, he's not available at the moment. Can I take a message?
sentences.zh: 真抱歉，他这会儿不在。我能记下口信吗？

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: That's okay. I'll try again later.
sentences.zh: 没关系，我过会儿再打。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 谢谢来电，再见。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: Excellent! Oh — I didn't call. That's a real call.
sentences.zh: 很好！等等，这通不是我打的。是真来电。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello? Tip Top Trading. This is Anna speaking.
sentences.zh: 你好，Tip Top Trading，我是 Anna。

sentences.speaker: Mr Lime
sentences.en: Hello Anna, this is Seb Lime, from Citrus Ventures. Call me Seb. Your Imperial Lemon is fantastic, and I was wondering if you'd like to do lunch with me sometime.
sentences.zh: Anna 你好，我是 Citrus Ventures 的 Seb Lime。叫我 Seb 就行。你们的 Imperial Lemon 非常好。不知道你哪天愿不愿意一起吃午饭。
sentences.note: I was wondering if… 提一个不太好直接说的请求。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Would you like to discuss the Imperial Lemon?
sentences.zh: 你是想谈 Imperial Lemon 吗？

sentences.speaker: Mr Lime
sentences.en: Forget the lemons. The reason I want to see you is more of a personal nature.
sentences.zh: 别提柠檬了。我想见你，是私人的事。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Personnel? Can I call you back? I'm afraid I'm a bit busy at the moment.
sentences.zh: 人事？我能过会儿打给你吗？我这会儿有点忙。

sentences.speaker: Denise
sentences.en: He means a personal nature, not personnel.
sentences.zh: 他是说私人的事，不是人事部门。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: Anna had an excellent phone manner. Let's hear those phrases again. Hello? Tip Top Trading. This is Anna speaking. How can I help you? Can I take a message? Shall I ask him to call you back? Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
sentences.zh: Anna 的电话礼数已经很好。我们再听一遍这些句子：报公司、报自己、问能帮什么、留口信、约回电话、谢谢来电再见。
